description: Source code for the EGL Loader in Android, managing dynamic loading of graphics driver libraries, including system, updated, and ANGLE drivers, with functions for initialization, unloading, and API setup.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Manages dynamic loading of EGL and GLES driver libraries, including ANGLE, system, and updated drivers, with functions for initialization, unloading, and API setup.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Loads the appropriate graphics driver libraries and initializes API function pointers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Unloads driver libraries and resets connection.

methods.name: initialize_api
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for EGL and GLES APIs from loaded driver.

methods.name: attempt_to_load_angle
methods.description: Attempts to load ANGLE graphics driver if configured.

methods.name: attempt_to_load_updated_driver
methods.description: Attempts to load updated (updatable) GLES or EGL drivers.

methods.name: attempt_to_load_system_driver
methods.description: Attempts to load system-provided GLES/EGL driver libraries based on suffix or exact name.

methods.name: unload_system_driver
methods.description: Unloads the system driver libraries and resets API pointers.

classes.name: Loader::driver_t
classes.description: Represents loaded driver libraries for GLES and EGL, manages their handles and cleanup.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a driver handle for a specific API type.
